name: Connecticut

jury_list.statute: Conn. Gen. Stat. 51-232(c)(1): the juror confirmation form and confidential juror questionnaire are held in confidence; 'Such completed questionnaires shall not constitute a public record.'

sources.cite: Conn. Gen. Stat. 51-217(a) (jurors may be electors, lawful permanent residents, or U.S. citizens)

voter_file.who_may_get: Lists of additions, restorations, removals, and name or address changes (with name, address, voting district, party) are available to the public under the Freedom of Information Act, 1-210 (Conn. Gen. Stat. 9-50a).
voter_file.permitted_uses: No purpose restriction found in chapter 143.

sources.cite: Conn. Gen. Stat. 9-50d (date of birth disclosed as month and year only, except for a governmental purpose)

private_challenge.who: At the polls: any elector may challenge a person offering to vote, but only on identity, disfranchisement, or lack of bona fide residence (Conn. Gen. Stat. 9-232(a)). Citizenship is not a listed ground. No pre-election written challenge by a private voter was found.
private_challenge.form_or_statute: Conn. Gen. Stat. 9-232. Not supported by JuryRoll.
private_challenge.evidence_standard: Challenges 'shall not be made indiscriminately' and only if the challenger knows, suspects or reasonably believes the person is not qualified; made under oath (9-232(b)).

county_board.name: Connecticut - find your town clerk and registrars of voters

ag.name: Connecticut Office of the Attorney General

gates.basis: Juror questionnaires are not public records (Conn. Gen. Stat. 51-232(c)(1)). Strict gates: counts only.

notes: Important: Connecticut lets lawful permanent residents serve as jurors (51-217(a)). A Connecticut juror record does not show who is or is not a citizen in the way other states' records do. The app should not treat Connecticut jury data as a non-citizen signal at all.

Source note: cga.ct.gov sends no intermediate certificate. On 2026-10-07 chapters 884, 143, 146 were re-fetched with TLS verification on. The chain was completed with GoDaddy's G2 intermediate and verified to a system root. The text matches every value in this file.
official_pipeline is null: no jury-to-registrar non-citizen pipeline was found.
